explanation.value: Keep resting sells in a min-heap by price and resting buys in a max-heap (a min-heap on negated price). For each incoming order, look at the best price on the opposite side; while it crosses the incoming limit and the incoming order still has quantity, trade the smaller of the two remaining quantities, add it to the total, and pop the resting order once it is empty. Push any remainder onto the order's own side. Remaining quantities live in a separate array indexed from the heap entries so partial fills can be updated in place.
